subject.title: Respect work days for Codex pace

question: Should persisted 4-, 5-, and 7-day Codex schedules always disable learned historical predictions, with historical pace used only when Work days is Automatic?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow, but it intentionally changes pace and ETA output for existing users whose stored explicit schedule was previously ignored once enough history existed.

options.title: Make explicit schedules authoritative
options.body: Approve the PR's precedence model so 4/5/7-day selections always use work-day-aware linear pacing while Automatic alone may use learned history.

options.title: Adapt historical curves to work days
options.body: Require the historical evaluator and dataset model to incorporate explicit work-day schedules instead of bypassing learned forecasting.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Keep the existing precedence until the Work days and historical-tracking product contract is redesigned and documented.

recommendation.title: Make explicit schedules authoritative
recommendation.body: Approve the PR's precedence model so 4/5/7-day selections always use work-day-aware linear pacing while Automatic alone may use learned history.

likelyOwner.reason: They integrated and refined the historical pace feature whose precedence contract requires confirmation.
